purpose: Qualify a single version-spanning Home Assistant observation/completion boundary and real /config custom-component load context on every selected VE2 source/runtime substrate without executing any T01/T02 scientific fixture or historical action.
required_per_role: The exact Better Thermostat component subtree is materialized under /config/custom_components/better_thermostat and imported from that path.
The component manifest identity equals the frozen source identity.
The exact selected Home Assistant OCI digest is used.
A state-parent event carrying a fresh Context is captured.
Exactly one synthetic consequential service event is captured and context-bound to that invocation.
A second state-parent invocation closes via the same completion witness with zero qualifying synthetic service events.
The completion witness is exactly three HomeAssistant.async_block_till_done fixed-point passes.
Foreign-context, duplicate-event, malformed-event, and incomplete-completion cases are rejected fail-closed.

version_adapter_law.homeassistant_constructor_selection: Use inspect.signature(HomeAssistant.__init__) only: if config_dir is a required positional parameter, construct HomeAssistant('/config'); otherwise construct HomeAssistant() and set hass.config.config_dir='/config'.

shared_boundary_law.context_binding: service context id equals invocation context id OR service context parent_id equals invocation context id

failure_law.pre_case_container_or_harness_failure: Preserve as infrastructure failure and require a versioned successor; do not infer substrate incompatibility from a harness defect.
failure_law.well_formed_boundary_mismatch: Preserve as E0Q qualification failure; do not weaken the boundary to obtain PASS.
